content: Standard ROS2 pattern for arbitrating multiple cmd_vel producers: twist_mux subscribes N labeled Twist/TwistStamped inputs with priority + timeout, republishes the highest-priority live one to a single downstream cmd_vel, and supports a 'lock' topic that can force-override to zero/stop (e-stop pattern). Nav2's nav2_velocity_smoother clamps accel/velocity jerk on the Nav2-side cmd_vel before it reaches the mux. Nav2's Collision Monitor is meant to be the last stage before the actual robot cmd_vel, re-checking against live sensor data and capping/zeroing the command if a collision is imminent -- explicitly documented as needing to be the final link in the chain. These are independent, well-established Nav2/ROS2 ecosystem packages, not RAI-specific. Source: docs.nav2.org (Velocity Smoother, Collision Monitor pages), robofoundry.medium.com twist_mux writeup.
